skill.name: Pierce
skill.description: Throw a fast moving spear that passes through enemies it kills.

passive.name: Martial Poise
passive.description: Enter a movement command while winding up Kalista's basic attack or Pierce to lunge a short distance when she launches her attack.

skill.name: Rend
skill.description: Attacks impale their targets with spears. Activate to rip the spears out, slowing and dealing escalating damage.

skill.name: Piercing Arrow
skill.description: Varus readies and then fires a powerful shot that gains extra range and damage the longer he spends preparing to fire.

skill.name: Hail of Arrows
skill.description: Varus fires a hail of arrows that deal physical damage and desecrate the ground. Desecrated ground slows enemies' Move Speed and reduces their self healing and regeneration.

skill.name: Blighted Quiver
skill.description: Passive: Varus' basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and apply Blight. Varus' other abilities detonate Blight, dealing magic damage based on the target's maximum Health. Active: Varus empowers his next Piercing Arrow.

skill.name: Jaws of the Beast
skill.description: Warwick lunges forward and bites his target, dealing damage based on their maximum health and healing for damage dealt.

passive.name: Frost Shot
passive.description:
Ashe's attacks slow their target, causing her to deal increased damage to these targets.

Ashe's critical strikes deal no bonus damage but apply an empowered slow to the target.

skill.name: Ranger's Focus
skill.description: Ashe builds up Focus by attacking. At maximum Focus, Ashe can cast Ranger's Focus to consume all stacks of Focus, temporarily increasing her Attack Speed and transforming her basic attack into a powerful flurry attack for the duration.

skill.name: Volley
skill.description: Ashe fires arrows in a cone for increased damage. Also applies Frost Shot.

skill.name: Venom Cask
skill.description: Twitch hurls a cask of venom that explodes in an area, slowing targets and applying deadly venom to the target.
